paragraphs.text:
Reflexively, you drop to the ground behind the couch as Joshua 
aims the gun your way. Thankfully, the shot goes over your 
head. You heave a sigh of relief, thankful for your safety.

And then the reality of the situation dawns on you. You dive 
for Officer Powell’s gun, which has fallen to the ground nearby. 
You scoop it up quickly, acting purely on instinct. You grip the 
weapon in both hands and prepare to return fire. You take a 
deep breath and aim the gun at Joshua.

• Make a Firearms (Handgun) roll: if you succeed, go to 120; if you 
fail, take 1D10+2 damage. If you survive this, go to 96; however, 
if this reduces you to zero hit points, then you have died from your 
wounds. Your visit to Esbury is over. THE END.
